correctness.rationale: For x length n, exactly t(x) first symbols of noninitial runs are deleted; y is subsequence, t(y)<=t(x), so |y|+t(y)<=n. Conversely each y with m+t(y)<=n is realized by duplicating the first symbol of every noninitial output run; append alternating singleton runs whose first symbol is deleted to pad to any n, possible for q>=2. Distinct channel outputs bound a zero-error code from above and one preimage for each attains the count. Counting output words by transitions yields the GF and characteristic-root capacity (including q=2 and n=1). Independent exhaustive direct input map for q=2 n<=11, q=3 n<=7, q=4 n<=5 matched every binomial count and allowed output condition; all n follow from explicit construction.

final_claim: The deterministic q-ary contextual deletion of every symbol after an original input run change (threshold k=1, deletion p=1) has output set exactly y nonempty with |y|+t(y)<=n, all-length maximal zero-error block count q sum_{m,t, m+t<=n} binom(m-1,t)(q-1)^t, GF qz/((1-z)(1-z-(q-1)z²)), and capacity log_q((1+sqrt(4q-3))/2).
